entry.text: Project – 1:
• Project name
- Classroom
• Client - Codingo Club Private Limited
• Role - Manual and API Tester
• Technologies - Manual Testing, API Testing (Postman), SQL, Mobile Testing,
Web Testing
Aptipro.ai is an innovative EdTech platform designed to enhance learning through
personalized assessments, interactive learning modules, and real -time progress
tracking. The platform supports both mobile and web applications, ensuring learning
accessibility across devices. It enables content creators to design, publish, and sell
courses and includes a classroom feature for conducting live tests.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Performed manual testing on web and mobile applications, ensuring proper
functionality, usability, and cross-platform compatibility.
• Conducted API testing using Postman, validating data flows, API endpoints,
error handling, and performance.
• Executed SQL-based database testing to ensure data integrity, consistency, and
validation, with a focus on data migration and backend processes.
• Involved in functional testing, regression testing, and UI/UX testing to ensure
a seamless and optimal user experience.
• Collaborated within Agile sprint cycles, participating in daily stand-ups,
sprint planning, defect resolution, and retrospective meetings to ensure
efficient and timely software delivery.
• Utilized JIRA for defect tracking, test case execution, and progress monitoring.
• Validated end-to-end integration workflows to ensure seamless
functionality and integration across multiple platform modules.

entry.text: Project – 2:
• Client - Bayview
• Role - Manual and API Tester
• Industry - Mortgage  Loan  Servicing
Bayview is a comprehensive Loan origination and mortgage processing platform designed
to streamline and digitize the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle. The system facilitates
automated loan underwriting, document verification, Eligibility checks, and Workflow-
based loan
approvals. It enables financial institutions to reduce manual effort, minimize errors,
accelerate approval timelines, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Created and validated orders via REST APIs for testing various business
scenarios
• Manually tested billing invoices as per business requirements to
ensure accurate and compliant billing
• Handled multiple change requests (CRs) and performed regression
testing across key modules
• Worked closely with cross-functional teams to align test coverage with
business workflows and priorities
• Actively participated in Test Plan meetings, collaborating with QA Leads
and Business Analysts to define and finalize the testing approach.
• Designed and executed test cases for functional testing, ensuring all system
requirements were accurately validated.
• Conducted manual testing and API testing to verify system functionality,
performance, and reliability.
• Performed multiple types of testing including functional testing, smoke
testing, sanity testing, system testing, regression testing, and retesting
to ensure product quality throughout various development phases.
• Debugged and executed test cases, analyzed results, and identified
defects to ensure optimal application performance.
• Conducted cross-browser compatibility testing on platforms like Chrome,
Firefox, and Microsoft Edge, ensuring a consistent user experience.
• Managed the bug lifecycle using JIRA, including defect identification,
tracking, and collaborating with developers for resolution.
• Documented and communicated testing progress, bug reports, and
enhancements to ensure alignment and clarity among cross-functional
teams.
